source.title: Stochastic Programming: Achievements and Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/2154259. The zbMATH API identified the exact work as Peter Kall's chapter 'Stochastic Programming: Achievements and Open Problems', zbMATH identifier 1177.90002, pages 285-302 in Models, Methods and Decision Support for Management.

Access failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted plus metadata_only. The exact DOI 10.1007/978-3-642-57603-4_16 resolved to a Springer chapter landing page with only abstract, references, and a subscription-access notice visible, not full problem text.

Crossref confirmed the DOI and Springer PDF lead for the same chapter. OpenAlex reported open_access.is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, oa_url=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. A Peter Kall bibliography mirror listed an author-page PDF path './bib/ka-01a.pdf', but the original www.ior.uzh.ch host could not be resolved and no readable exact-work PDF was recovered during bounded exact-title, exact-title-plus-PDF, and filename searches.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the chapter's problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from bibliographic metadata, abstracts, table-of-contents entries, search snippets, or related works. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-2154259.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
